about: THE one place for ClipForge's outside addresses. A value that starts with / is a page of 'site'. Readers: tool/ci/make_latest_json.py (writes them into latest.json, so installed apps follow without a new build), tool/ci/make_readme_html.py, web/scripts/build-content.mjs (the website) and test/core/links_test.dart (the app's built-in copy in lib/core/links.dart must be equal). See docs/RENAMING.md.
